title.narrative: Monitoring and evaluation and program support for the implementation of the managing climate risks for the urban poor programme

description.narrative: This activity Monitoring and evaluation and program support for the implementation of the managing climate risks for the urban poor programme is a component of Managing Climate Risks for Urban Poor reported by FCDO with a funding type of 104 - Procurement of Services and a budget of £732,625. This project benefits Asia, regional. It works in the following sector(s): Environmental policy and administrative management, Urban development and management.
